content.what_it_is: MATLAB script plotting eta and cohesive sediment concentration snapshots for the FUNWAVE-TVD single_vessel_cohesive case. Loads dep_00000 from output/ (L2, L5), mirrors the half-domain N=2*n-1 (L8), dx=dy=1.0 (L11-L12). For three snapshots nfile=[40 80 120] (L18) with time labels min={'200' '400' '600'} sec (L20), loads eta_, mask_, C_ (L36-L38), masks with mask<1 (L40-L41), mirrors ETA and CH about the symmetry axis (L44-L47), and fills a 6x1 tight_subplot stack (L30) in pairs with ax=[0 4500 0 120] (L31): odd panels show ETA pcolor with caxis [-0.3 1.0] and time title (L49-L58), even panels show CH pcolor in linear scale caxis [0 1.2] with colorbar ' C (g/L) ' (L62-L69); xlabel only on the final panel (L72-L74). Prints wakes_cohesive_sed.jpg (L80). Structure parallels multi_vessel_morphology/plot_wave.m but with linear concentration (no log10, no mg/L conversion) and local output/ directory.
entities: min time-label cell array L20 (shadows builtin min)
unresolved: time labels '200'/'400'/'600' sec for snapshots 40/80/120 imply a 5 s output interval, unlike the multi_vessel plot_wave.m which labels the same snapshot numbers as 80/160/240 sec; neither interval is verifiable from these scripts alone
concentration plotted linearly as C (g/L) caxis [0 1.2] (L64-L65, L69) whereas the multi_vessel script converts with 2680*1000 to mg/L and takes log10; unit convention difference unexplained
variable min shadows the builtin; tight_subplot is an external dependency
